name: notes playbook
description: Apple Notes mastery: AppleScript bulk ops, HTML styling, inline images, website-quality notes

create_html_note.description: Create a rich HTML-formatted note with tables, styled sections, colors, and emoji icons
steps: applescript: make new note at folder 'Notes' of default account with properties {body:htmlString}
HTML supports: h1-h3, p, b, i, u, hr, ul/li, ol/li, table, a href, br
Inline CSS works: style='color:#00e5ff; background-color:#0a1a1c; border-radius:12px; font-size:28px;'
Tables create card layouts: cellpadding for spacing, cellspacing for gaps, vertical-align:top
create_html_note.example:
set h to "

Title

Card
Description
"

inline_image_paste.description: Place images at exact positions inside a note using clipboard paste (not make new attachment which only appends to end)
steps: Step 1: Create the full note content via AppleScript with HTML body
Step 2: Copy image to clipboard via Bash: osascript -e 'set the clipboard to (read (POSIX file "/path/to/image.png") as «class PNGf»)'
Step 3: Focus Notes app: focus({bundleId:'com.apple.Notes'})
Step 4: Use Find to position cursor: cmd+f → type target text → escape
Step 5: Navigate: cmd+left (start of line) → up (line above)
Step 6: Paste: cmd+v (image appears inline at cursor position)
Repeat steps 2-6 for each image at different positions
gotchas: make new attachment at end of attachments ONLY appends to bottom — never inline
cmd+right in Notes goes to end of ENTIRE note, not end of line — use arrow keys instead
Copy image via Bash osascript, not via ScreenHand applescript tool (read command is blocked)
Always focus Notes before pasting — switching apps moves cursor

bulk_read_notes.description: Read all notes via AppleScript (100x faster than UI automation)
bulk_read_notes.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to ""
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        set output to output & "---" & return & name of n & return & plaintext of n & return
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

bulk_delete_by_name.description: Delete specific notes by name (safer than pattern matching)
bulk_delete_by_name.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set noteNames to {"Note One", "Note Two", "Note Three"}
    repeat with noteName in noteNames
        try
            delete note noteName of default account
        end try
    end repeat
end tell
gotchas: Deleting inside a loop shifts the list — wrap in 'repeat 5 times' outer loop
'items' is a reserved word — use taskList, noteList etc
container of note errors out — skip folder name, query folder-specific instead

search_notes.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set results to {}
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        if plaintext of n contains "keyword" then
            set end of results to name of n
        end if
    end repeat
    return results
end tell

move_note.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set sourceNote to note "My Note" of default account
    set targetFolder to folder "Target Folder" of default account
    move sourceNote to targetFolder
end tell

export_all_notes.description: Export all notes to files (two-step: AppleScript dumps, Bash writes files)
export_all_notes.snippet_step1:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to ""
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        set output to output & "<<<NOTE_START>>>" & name of n & "<<<NOTE_SEP>>>" & plaintext of n & "<<<NOTE_END>>>"
    end repeat
    return output
end tell
export_all_notes.snippet_step2: # Bash/Python: parse output file, split by delimiters, write each note to ~/Desktop/notes-export/
gotchas: do shell script is blocked in ScreenHand applescript tool — must use two-step approach

count_per_folder.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to ""
    repeat with f in folders of default account
        set output to output & name of f & ": " & (count of notes of f) & " notes" & return
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

find_duplicates.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set titles to {}
    set dupes to {}
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        set t to name of n
        if titles contains t then
            if dupes does not contain t then set end of dupes to t
        else
            set end of titles to t
        end if
    end repeat
    return dupes
end tell

merge_notes.description: Merge multiple notes into one with HTML
merge_notes.snippet:
tell application "Notes" set note1 to note "First Note" of default account set note2 to note "Second Note" of default account set combined to "

Merged Note

" & body of note1 & "
" & body of note2 make new note at folder "Notes" of default account with properties {body:combined} end tell

bulk_tag.snippet:
tell application "Notes" set n to note "My Note" of default account set body of n to (body of n) & "
#newtag" end tell

list_titles_only.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to {}
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        set end of output to name of n
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

delete_by_pattern.description: Delete notes matching a pattern (wraps 5x for list shifting)
delete_by_pattern.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    repeat 5 times
        repeat with n in notes of default account
            if name of n starts with "Test" then delete n
        end repeat
    end repeat
end tell

move_from_folder.description: Move a note from a specific folder back to Notes
move_from_folder.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set sourceNote to note "My Note" of folder "Source Folder" of default account
    set targetFolder to folder "Notes" of default account
    move sourceNote to targetFolder
end tell

list_with_dates.description: List notes with creation and modification dates
list_with_dates.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to ""
    repeat with n in notes of default account
        set output to output & name of n & " | created: " & (creation date of n as string) & " | modified: " & (modification date of n as string) & return
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

bulk_rename.description: Rename a note by prepending a new h1 title to body
bulk_rename.snippet:
tell application "Notes" set n to note "Old Title" of default account set body of n to "

New Title

" & body of n end tell

get_metadata.description: Get note metadata: name, ID, dates, password status
get_metadata.snippet:
tell application "Notes"
    set n to note "My Note" of default account
    return "Name: " & name of n & return & "ID: " & id of n & return & "Created: " & (creation date of n as string) & return & "Modified: " & (modification date of n as string) & return & "Password protected: " & (password protected of n as string)
end tell

bulk_create_from_list.description: Create multiple notes from a list of titles

steps: applescript: make new folder with properties {name:'Folder Name'}
applescript: delete folder 'Folder Name' of default account

website_style_note.description: Create a website-quality note mirroring a Next.js site structure with Hero, Problem, Solution, Features, Comparison, Demo, CTA sections
steps: Step 1: Build full HTML body with styled sections using tables for card layouts
Step 2: Use inline CSS for colors (color:#00e5ff), backgrounds (background-color:#0a1a1c), borders, border-radius
Step 3: Use <table border='0' cellpadding='15' cellspacing='8'> for card grids

Step 4: Use
between sections, styled

tags for section labels
Step 5: Add comparison tables with emoji checkmarks (✅/❌)
Step 6: Add CTA with styled button-like table cells (background-color:#00e5ff; border-radius:25px)
Step 7: Paste images inline at exact positions using Find+cursor+clipboard technique
